title: NCCRs of cones over del Pezzo surfaces
summary: Non-commutative crepant resolutions (NCCRs) are non-commutative versions of classical crepant resolutions in algebraic geometry. For 3-dimensional terminal Gorenstein singularities Iyama and Wemyss proved that all NCCRs are connected by mutations, which may be viewed as a non-commutative analogue of Kawamata's result that all crepant resolutions are connected by flops. In this paper we prove the corresponding result for a class of canonical Gorenstein singularities which are not terminal, namely anticanonical cones over del Pezzo surfaces.
